column1: # Rune Factory 3 Special 1.0.3: Unity 2020.3.40f1, SDK 14.3.0, NVN, native SanDLL NRO.
# Static modules; the NRR-registered SanDLL plugin is collected automatically.
# Unity and StandardAllocator use virtual address regions; the heap partition is unused on the tested route.
# nninitStartup reserves pool - used in StandardAllocator; Unity separately reserves resource regions.
# 1 GiB keeps those reservations within the 5 GiB layout (the default pool exhausted it at asset loading).
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
